nodes.title: W2-E BR1: POST /api/lesson/turn's orchestration moved from server/routes/lesson.js into server/brain/turn.js (lessonTurn(req, body) is the exported turn handler W2-G's turn-audio calls), the reply and its guards into server/brain/say.js, rows and lanes into server/brain/rows.js; the route is a thin adapter and re-exports every old import path; behaviour-identical by replay

W2-E BR1: server/brain/kernel.js arbitrate() is live on every turn: proposals from the Director (its move, mandatory in its rank; a safeguard freezes everything below), the relational directive, Studio's turn view, the whiteboard ask and the vibe knobs; 13 authority ranks read from priority (100 - 10 x rank + urgency), vetoes act downward, attention budget 1, the §10.3 conflict table; pure and deterministic

W2-E BR0: 016_brain.sql (brain_trace, decision_record, lesson_plan, format_posterior population-only) keys every per-child row by lesson_id ON DELETE CASCADE (no new child_id column, so erasure and the M0 ratchet remove them with the lesson); one brain_trace row per committed turn inside the turn's transaction, codes and digests only; written only once a per-process probe sees the table (a deploy before the migration never fails a turn)

W2-E BR5: server/brain/relational-adapter.js splits W2-I's RelationalDirective into the kernel's ranks (SAFETY/floorFix rank 0; RELEASE rank 1 as the turn's move; CHECK_IN rank 1 overlay; OWN_SLIP/AFFIRM_RECHECK rank 7 repair; WARM_BOUNDARY/POINT_OUT rank 8 merged; rapport rank 10); an accepted RELEASE or relational SAFETY re-plans the turn through the Director's own stop / safeguarding path; an accepted overlay rides state.rel for one turn for the compile

W2-E BR2: server/brain/moment.js momentOf builds one Moment per turn (move, verdict for licences only, engagement from learner/affect.js engagementOf, teacherAffect only from the relational directive else neutral_warm cause none, calm_steady on safety, bond stage, band, lang); it goes to expressiveSeam.planDelivery and on the wire as TurnResponse.moment; ui.teacherAffect still rides only when a directive exists

W2-E: every turn carries ui.beat {beatId, type, index} read from the Director's move (server/brain/beat.js; a misconception re-teach is a contrast beat; hint/repair continue the beat), stored as state.beat; BR3 (W3) makes beats the planning unit

W2-E (owner priority 6): on an explanation beat (explain, worked_example, contrast, explore_question, recap) the kernel considers a Studio whiteboard ask (rank 12, attention 1; never on the voice lane, during strain, on a closing move or a late answer); when accepted, the guarded line and the move's kit content go to server/studio/seam.js requestIntent(StudioAsk) and an ack opens ui.studioSlot (tray studio) for the drawing script; the seam function is W2-H's to add

W2-E BR2: the classify signals block (act with the IDK split, personal_share, interest from the one registry, humour) and its consumers (affect frustration/break counters and the IDK split, persona meta_slow and humour) are built but OFF (TAXILA_CLASSIFY_SIGNALS=1): G-SIG label agreement on the production classifier was 58/60, under the 99% bar

W2-E L5 / failure drill: a classify call that fails (not a content-filter block) is retried once on taxila-fast (TAXILA_CLASSIFY_FALLBACK, '0' = off; never the deployment that failed); a content-filter block still fails closed to safeguarding

W2-E: server/lanes.js caps background calls at 30% of a shared deployment's TPM over a sliding minute (FIFO queue, delayed never dropped), pauses a deployment's background traffic 10 s after a hot 429 (5 s after a background 429), never delays hot or untagged calls; capacities from BUILD-PLAN §10.2 (TAXILA_TPM overrides); twinFor() names O13 twins from TAXILA_BG_TWINS for azure.js

W2-E BR2b L1 (turn.predictive, default OFF): the cascade transcription VAD ends a fragment at 500 ms and src/lesson/turnModel.ts holds a fragment that reads unfinished (trailing connective/filler, a short start of an explanation) for 0.8-1.5 s by the beat, merging the child's continuation into one turn; numbers and taps are never held; the Smart Turn model is not shipped (no ONNX runtime, unvalidated on Hindi/Hinglish), so the transcript heuristic scores

W2-E: HOLDING is realised in the cascade link's fragment merger (the floor shows the heard receipt, then listening if the child goes on), not as a ninth Floor state: a new Floor value would break the Record<Floor> maps in W2-A/W2-D files
W2-E applied W2-B's screen guard (screenContradiction → 'parts') to the teacher's OWN words only (the posed kit question excluded, as the units guard does), a deviation from the patch as written

evals/teacher-brain/replay drives the REAL turn handler over 30 scripted lessons (classes 3-8, 3 languages, 3 lanes, maths/science/EVS, 420 turns) with an ESM loader swapping server/db.js and server/azure.js for deterministic fakes; --write/--check (full) and --write-digest/--check-digest (golden.digest.json) prove a refactor byte-identical; tests/brain-turn.test.mjs runs it for determinism and the turn invariants

BR1 replay: 30 lessons, 420 turns (hook 30, explain 54, worked 33, practice 84, hint 83, probe 74, wrap 30, safeguard 10, repair 14, retrieval 5, reteach 3) byte-identical (responses + every transaction statement) before vs after moving the turn into server/brain/; after the kernel: identical with the additive beat/moment fields and brain-table statements stripped

G-SIG A (evals/classify-accuracy.mjs, grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning, 20 cases x 3 reps per arm, US sandbox): label agreement plain vs signals 58/60 (96.7%, bar 99%), exact 56/60 → 54/60, graded-wrong 0 → 0, distress 15/15 both, p50 816 → 943 ms; both disagreements were edges-vs-corners misconception → incorrect

G-SIG B (evals/teacher-brain/g-sig.mjs, 120 replies, 10 acts x 12, Hinglish/Hindi/English, labels written before the run, SINGLE rater): acts 115/120 (0.958); IDK split 24/24; misses: clarify→curious 1, frustration→idk/break 2, pride→chit-chat 1, slow→break 1; p50 1376 ms at 6-wide concurrency

Kernel gates (tests/brain-kernel.test.mjs, seeded generators): G-KERNEL-PURE 500 turns byte-equal + order-independent with clock/random trapped; G-KERNEL-ORDER 5k; G-BUDGET 10k (one move, attention <= 1, no reveal on a closing move, no callback in a correction); G-AUTHORITY 10k (RELEASE wins every turn without a disclosure, safety outranks it); G-LAT p99 well under 10 ms over 10k turns (Node, sandbox; the ACA-image run is open)

G-QUOTA (tests/brain-lanes.test.mjs, fake clock, a 500k-TPM deployment enforced over a sliding minute): 20 Studio races (2 x 12k) + 40 consolidations (2k) at t=0 beside live classify+reply (5.5k tokens/s, 66% TPM) for 3 min: hot 429s 0 with lanes (all 80 background calls ran, delayed), > 0 without lanes

tests/prod/w2e-brain.mjs against node server/serve.mjs (dist built) on the Neon test branch with 016 applied: 16/16 (7-turn text lesson with ui.beat and Moment on every turn, beats hook → explain → worked_example → practice_set, a disclosure → safeguard with the helpline and a calm Moment, one brain_trace row per turn with codes only); failure drill (DEPLOY_CLASSIFY = a deployment that does not exist): 17/17, 8/8 classify 404s answered by the taxila-fast fallback; account deleted, leftover guardians 4 → 4

In the 420-turn replay the whiteboard ask was proposed on 66 explanation-beat turns: accepted 14 (tray free), refused 52 for attention because W2-B's explainer@1 rung (or an engine) was already drawing in the module tray

A token bucket for the background share (capacity = one minute's 30%, starting full) lets background spend ~2x its share in the first minute (the full bucket + the refill): in the G-QUOTA simulation it caused 28 hot 429s; replaced by a sliding-minute window

Switching the classify signals block on for production now: label agreement with the plain arm 58/60 (< 99%), both disagreements turning an edges-vs-corners misconception into 'incorrect' (the misconception signal the comprehension engine lives on); +127 ms p50

Running W2-B's screenContradiction on the whole reply: it flagged the kit's own verified question ('Halves, quarters aur eighths wali fraction wall…') beside a 1/2-only predict screen, costing a rewrite and her lead-in sentence

W2-E open items: W2-H requestIntent seam; compile rendering state.rel overlays; W2-C state.js passing cls.signals to turnSignals and reading affect.idk; Smart Turn assets + ONNX runtime; G-SIG two-rater act set; Central India turn timing; G-LAT on the ACA image; scanSafety misses 'mujhe ghar pe bahut maar padti hai'
